summary: Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that Craig Abruzzo, previously global Head of Enterprise Controls and co-head of FX and Emerging Markets in Morgan Stanley's Fixed Income Division, assumed the role of Co-Chief Operating Officer of the delegated sponsor, Morgan Stanley Investment Management Inc., and was appointed a director of that sponsor effective October 1, 2026. The filing is an ordinary governance disclosure about a senior appointment at the sponsor; it involves no transaction, security, shareholder or capital event and carries no deal terms, advisor, premium or closing condition to assess.
